title: EDUvision
description: Comprehensive smart education platform with personalized learning, student comprehension analytics, FAISS vector search, and intelligent educational assistant agents.
tagline: Smart Adaptive AI Tutoring & Learning Platform
architecture: RetinaFace 60 FPS face detection & 68-point biometric landmark mesh
ArcFace facial cosine embeddings & ByteTrack multi-target object tracking
FAISS vector similarity retrieval over Egyptian STEM curriculum
Thoth Socratic AI dialogue engine with Qwen-2.5-Coder & KaTeX math reasoning
Hardware ESP32/RC522 NFC attendance scanner bridge over COM serial
overview: EDUvision is the next evolution of AI-driven EdTech, tailored to the Egyptian STEM curriculum and modern digital classrooms. It converges real-time computer vision proctoring, hardware IoT RFID/NFC attendance logging, and a cognitive Socratic AI tutor grounded with FAISS vector embeddings and Qwen-2.5-Coder. Rather than merely supplying direct answers, the Socratic tutor guides students through deductive reasoning steps and mathematical proofs while actively auditing cognitive engagement.
problemSolved: Traditional online classrooms lack physiological engagement auditing, allowing cognitive drift and cheating, while static LMS chatbots hallucinate ungrounded answers. EDUvision bridges physical attendance via ESP32 hardware, monitors cognitive focus via RetinaFace and 3D head-pose telemetry, and guarantees zero-hallucination pedagogical reasoning using vector-grounded curriculum retrieval.

keyFeatures.title: RetinaFace 3D Mesh Proctoring
keyFeatures.desc: High-frequency 60 FPS face detection, 68-point neural landmark mesh, and ArcFace biometric cosine verification with anti-spoofing.

keyFeatures.title: Thoth Socratic Reasoning Agent
keyFeatures.desc: Adaptive RAG tutor grounded on Egyptian STEM textbooks using FAISS vector indexing to challenge students through deductive prompts.

keyFeatures.title: Hardware NFC Attendance Bridge
keyFeatures.desc: ESP32 microcontroller integration over UART COM serial at 9600 baud rate with Mifare RFID card scanning and automated classroom roster logging.

keyFeatures.title: 30-Min Real-Time Attention Dynamics
keyFeatures.desc: Live WebSockets telemetry streaming rolling focus curves, head pose stability metrics, and concept progression trees.

title: DevGuard
description: Automated static code security and vulnerability diagnostics engine powered by fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder SLM (PEFT/QLoRA) combined with deterministic AST parsing.
tagline: Automated Code Security & Static Vulnerability Engine
architecture: AST static dependency & taint analysis tree parsing
Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder SLM for vulnerability classification
CVE matching & severity scoring matrix with CWE-120 tracking
Automated AST-safe code patch synthesis and remediation diffs
overview: DevGuard is an automated static code security and vulnerability diagnostics platform powered by fine-tuned Small Language Models (Qwen2.5-Coder via PEFT/QLoRA) paired with deterministic Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analyzers.
problemSolved: Traditional regex linters generate excessive false positives, while cloud LLMs risk exposing proprietary source code. DevGuard runs locally with a 4-bit quantized SLM, detecting zero-day memory leaks, buffer overflows, and injection flaws in seconds.

keyFeatures.title: Hybrid AST & Neural Taint Analysis
keyFeatures.desc: Traces untrusted user inputs across control-flow graphs to pinpoint injection, buffer overflow, and memory vulnerabilities.

keyFeatures.title: Fine-Tuned SLM Code Auditor
keyFeatures.desc: Qwen2.5-Coder quantized with 4-bit QLoRA, delivering near-zero false positive vulnerability classifications.

keyFeatures.title: Automated Remediation Diffs
keyFeatures.desc: Generates verified, AST-safe code remediation diffs ready for direct pull-request integration.

title: docugraph
description: Context engineering platform for evaluating semantic chunking strategies, 3D vector embeddings, and cross-encoder retrieval coherence over complex technical documents.

Context compression pipeline saving up to 52% prompt tokens
overview: docugraph is an interactive RAG context engineering and chunking diagnostics workbench designed for evaluating dense vector retrieval, evaluating boundary chunk coherence, and inspecting 3D embedding cluster distributions over complex technical documentation.
problemSolved: Blind chunking leads to severed context and RAG retrieval failure. docugraph visualizes semantic chunk boundaries, token losses, and cross-encoder rerank dynamics to guarantee high precision in enterprise search.

keyFeatures.title: Semantic Boundary Scoring
keyFeatures.desc: Evaluates recursive vs. semantic chunk boundaries with token consumption metrics and loss graphs.

keyFeatures.title: Context Compression Engine
keyFeatures.desc: Computes cross-attention reranking scores and token compression algorithms saving up to 52% prompt tokens.

keyFeatures.title: 3D Vector Embedding Space
keyFeatures.desc: Interactive projection of high-dimensional document vectors into 3D clusters with cosine distance inspection.

title: SchemaForge

overview: SchemaForge is a DDL-grounded Text-to-SQL synthesis engine with relational schema awareness, static anti-pattern linting, query execution cost profiling, and automated database index recommendations.
problemSolved: Generic LLMs frequently produce syntactically valid yet structurally invalid or catastrophically slow SQL queries. SchemaForge verifies queries against relational DDL constraints and generates covering indexes to protect databases from unbounded scans.

keyFeatures.title: DDL Relational Graph Linking
keyFeatures.desc: Constructs an in-memory graph of foreign key relationships, primary keys, and table schemas.

keyFeatures.title: Cost Curve & Execution Profiler
keyFeatures.desc: Predicts query execution complexity (I/O, CPU, memory) before database execution.

keyFeatures.title: Automated Index Synthesizer
keyFeatures.desc: Recommends covering and composite indexes to optimize slow joins and aggregation queries.
